Name: Ibzan, Judge of Israel
Summary: Ibzan of Beth-lehem judged Israel seven years; he had thirty sons and thirty daughters, whom he married outside his family.
KeyStory: Ibzan judged Israel seven years from Bethlehem, sending thirty daughters abroad and bringing thirty daughters in for his thirty sons, and was buried in Bethlehem.
LifeLesson: A judge remembered for marriages, not battles.
